subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Maya Lin was a Chinese American architect who studied at Yale University.
• The Vietnam Veterans Memorial is a notable design by Lin.
• It uses a minimalist approach with black granite walls.
• This memorial was completed in 1982.
prompt: The student wants to indicate the year the Vietnam Veterans Memorial was completed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Vietnam Veterans Memorial was completed in 1982.
choices.B: While studying at Yale, Lin created minimalist architectural designs.
choices.C: Lin, a Chinese American architect, created a notable memorial design.
choices.D: Lin used a minimalist approach with black granite walls.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence indicates the year the Vietnam Veterans Memorial was completed, stating that it was completed in 1982.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence identifies the approach and materials Lin used; it doesn't indicate when the memorial was completed.
